title: Past Continuous: was / were + -ing
grammarNote: Past Continuous описывает действие, которое ПРОДОЛЖАЛОСЬ в определённый момент в прошлом. Образуется из was/were + глагол с окончанием -ing. Оно часто используется вместе с Past Simple — чтобы показать, что одно действие (длинное, фон) прерывалось другим (короткое, главное событие). Сигнальное слово for Past Continuous в таком контексте: WHEN (когда произошло краткое действие) и WHILE (пока оба действия длились одновременно).

grammarTable.subject: I / He / She / It
grammarTable.example: I was sleeping at midnight. · She was running when it started raining.

grammarTable.subject: We / You / They
grammarTable.example: They were studying when the power went out.

grammarTable.subject: I / He / She / It
grammarTable.example: He wasn't sleeping — he was listening to music.

grammarTable.subject: We / You / They
grammarTable.example: They weren't celebrating — they were panicking.

grammarTable.subject: Was I / he / she...?
grammarTable.example: Was she studying when you called? — Yes, she was.

grammarTable.subject: Were we / you / they...?
grammarTable.example: Were they sleeping? — No, they weren't.

rows.form: ① In progress at a past moment
rows.example: "At 11 p.m. last night, I was revising for an exam." = ongoing at that time.
"She was sleeping WHEN the power went out." = PC is the background; PS is the event.
"While Kamila was telling stories, Rustam was scaring everyone." = both ongoing.

rows.form: ④ Setting the scene in a story
rows.example: "The wind was howling. Snow was hitting the windows. Kamila was studying..." = narrative atmosphere.
"I was going to submit my essay, but the power went out." = intended but didn't happen.
"...when the power went out." = sudden, completed event.
"She was studying WHEN the lights went off." = studying (background) interrupted by lights off (event).
"The lights went off WHEN she was studying." = same meaning, different word order.
"When I got to the station, I bought a ticket." = one completed action after another. (NOT continuous)
"While Amir was writing, Kamila was sleeping." = both actions in progress simultaneously.
"While he was typing, he got a notification." = longer action + interrupting event.
"While the students were studying, the wind was howling outside."
"WHEN" often introduces the short event. "WHILE" often introduces the long background action.
✅ "I was studying at midnight." — always need -ing with was/were!
✅ "She was sleeping." — I/he/she/it → was. We/you/they → were.
✅ "What were you doing?" — Past Continuous question uses were/was, not did.
✅ "I knew the answer." — stative verbs (know/want/like) NEVER in Continuous.

grammarTip:
Past Continuous — три ключевых правила:
① was = I/he/she/it. were = we/you/they. Никогда не путай!
② В вопросе — инверсия: Was she sleeping? (НЕ 'She was sleeping?')
③ Stative verbs (know/like/want/believe) — НИКОГДА в Continuous, даже в прошедшем!

💡 Самый частый паттерн на экзамене:
«PC (длинное действие) + when + PS (короткое событие)»
→ "I WAS STUDYING when the power WENT OUT."
PC = фон. PS = событие, которое прерывает фон.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Past Continuous form.
exercises.text: At midnight, Kamila ___ for her linguistics exam.
exercises.hint: Kamila = she → "was studying". At midnight = specific past moment → Past Continuous.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Continuous form.
exercises.text: The wind ___ (howl) and snow ___ (hit) the windows all night.
exercises.hint: Setting the scene (narrative): was howling / was hitting. Both = background actions.
Rustam = he = singular → wasn't (not weren't). wasn't celebrating ✅

exercises.text: "___ Zhibek ___ a shower when the messages arrived?"
exercises.hint: Zhibek = she = singular → Was she having...? Past Continuous question: Was/Were + subject + verb-ing?

exercises.text: "They were know the answer" is correct Past Continuous.
exercises.hint: "know" is a stative verb — NEVER used in Continuous. ✅ "They knew the answer."

exercises.text: While Amir ___ (type) his essay, Kamila ___ (sleep) in her room.
exercises.hint: While + PC, PC = two simultaneous background actions. was typing / was sleeping.

exercises.text: Which sentence sets the scene correctly?
opts: The students were studying. The wind howled.
The students studied. The wind was howling.
The students were studying. The wind was howling.
The students studied. The wind howled.
exercises.correct: The students were studying. The wind was howling.
exercises.hint: Scene-setting uses Past Continuous for all background actions: were studying + was howling = both ongoing.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form for the short event.
exercises.text: She was reading when the lights ___ .
exercises.hint: "the lights went out" = short, sudden event = Past Simple. "She was reading" = background = Past Continuous.

exercises.text: I ___ sleeping, but my friends ___ talking in the corridor.
exercises.hint: I → was. My friends = they (plural) → were.

exercises.instruction: Which use of Past Continuous is in this sentence: "I was planning to submit my essay, but the power went out."
opts: A background action interrupted by an event
A past intention that didn't happen
exercises.correct: A past intention that didn't happen
exercises.hint: "was going to / was planning to" = intended future action at that time. The power going out prevented it.

exercises.text: "Were you study when I called?" is a correctly formed Past Continuous question.
exercises.hint: ✅ "Were you STUDYING when I called?" — always need -ing! "Were you study" is impossible.

exercises.instruction: Complete the story sentence with Past Continuous.
exercises.text: It was a cold night. The students ___ (sit) in the hallway and ___ (share) stories.
exercises.hint: Narrative scene-setting. Students = they (plural) → were sitting / were sharing.

questions.text: "At 11 p.m., Kamila ___ for her exam." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: At 11 p.m. = specific past moment → Past Continuous. Kamila → was studying.

questions.text: "They ___ when the power went out." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: They = plural → were sleeping. Background action interrupted by "power went out".

questions.text: "___ she sleeping when you called?" — "Yes, she ___."
questions.hint: She = singular → Was she sleeping? Short answer: "Yes, she was." (not "Yes, she were.")

questions.text: The -ing form of "run" used in Past Continuous is:
questions.hint: run: CVC → double n + ing: running. "He was running to class."
"While" + two simultaneous actions = both Past Continuous: was playing / was writing.

questions.text: "I ___ when you sent the message." Choose the stative verb answer.
questions.hint: "know" is stative → Past Simple negative: "didn't know". Never "wasn't knowing".

questions.text: "The wind ___ (blow) hard all night." Use Past Continuous.
questions.hint: The wind = it → was blowing. An ongoing background action throughout the night.

questions.text: "She was reading a novel when Rustam ___ ." Which event interrupted?
questions.hint: The interrupting event (shorter, sudden) = Past Simple: "arrived". The ongoing activity = Past Continuous.

questions.text: "What ___ you ___ when the announcement came?" Form the question.
questions.hint: "What were you doing?" — Past Continuous question: were + subject + verb-ing.

questions.text: "She weren't sleeping." is correct Past Continuous.
questions.hint: ✅ "She wasn't sleeping." — she/he/it → WAS, not WERE. "She weren't" is wrong.

questions.text: Which sentence uses Past Continuous for scene-setting?
opts: Snow was falling and students were gathering in the corridor.
questions.correct: Snow was falling and students were gathering in the corridor.
questions.hint: Scene-setting = multiple ongoing Past Continuous actions creating the atmosphere/background.

questions.text: "I ___ (plan) to submit my essay, but the power cut stopped me."
questions.hint: "was planning to" = past intention that didn't happen. A use of Past Continuous for frustrated plans.

questions.text: "He was running to the station when he ___ his ticket." Choose.
questions.hint: "dropped the ticket" = short, sudden accident = Past Simple. "was running" = background = Past Continuous.

questions.text: "___ the students celebrating or panicking?" Complete the question.
questions.hint: "the students" = they (plural) → Were they celebrating or panicking? ✅
At 6:15 a.m. = specific past moment → Past Continuous. The train = it → was leaving.

questions.text: "While she was having a shower, her phone ___ ." Complete.
questions.hint: Both actions happening at the same time → both Past Continuous OR PS for the shorter one. "was buzzing" = also ongoing → PC.
